short: Steals logins and passwords to act in the name of real people.
analogy: Takes a bunch of keys off the security desk board.

solutionNotes.edr: Blocks dumping of passwords from memory and password-stealing programs.
solutionNotes.siem: Spots password guessing and unusual requests to domain controllers.
solutionNotes.mfa: Even a stolen password doesn’t let anyone in without the second factor.
solutionNotes.ueba: Spots a login from an unusual place, device or time.
solutionNotes.deception: Fake bait passwords: trying to use one gives the attacker away.
solutionNotes.pam: Administrator passwords are kept in a vault and changed regularly.
solutionNotes.soar: Automatically blocks the account and resets sessions at signs of theft.
